services.name: Netflix
steps: Open netflix.com/cancelplan in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel

services.note: Netflix says this page is the only way to cancel. No cancel button = billed by a partner (shown under Membership on netflix.com/account). New Apple sign-ups ended years ago, old ones may still bill via Apple.
services.answer: Go to netflix.com/cancelplan and sign in. Tap Cancel, then Finish Cancellation, and keep the confirmation email. Deleting the Netflix app doesn’t cancel it.
tips: Netflix stopped new sign-ups through Apple years ago, but older ones may still be billed by Apple. If your statement says APPLE.COM/BILL, cancel on your iPhone instead.
services.partner: No cancel button on that page? A partner bills you, like your phone, internet or TV company. Netflix shows which one under Membership on netflix.com/account. Cancel with them.

access.text: You can keep watching until the end of the billing period you paid for.
access.quote: If you cancel with time left in your billing period, you can use Netflix until the end of the billing period.

data.text: Netflix keeps your viewing activity, ratings, account details and game saves for 24 months after your account closes, so it's all there if you come back.

refunds.text: Netflix's terms say payments aren't refunded, and there's no refund or credit for a part-used month.
refunds.quote: Payments are nonrefundable and there are no refunds or credits for partially used subscription periods.

verify.text: How to check it worked: Netflix emails you a confirmation. Your Payment History shows the date your account closes.
verify.quote: A confirmation email will be sent to the email on the account. ... To see when your account will close, check your Payment History.

pause.text: Just want a break? Netflix lets you pause for 1 month at a time, up to 3 months in total. You can't watch while paused. Not on the Basic plan or some payment methods, like gift cards and some partners.
pause.quote: On your next billing date, you will not be charged and your membership will be paused for 1 month. ... Accounts can only be paused for a total of 3 months.

faq.q: Does deleting the Netflix app cancel it?
faq.a: No. Netflix says signing out or deleting the app doesn't cancel your account. You have to finish the cancel steps.
faq.quote: Signing out of your account or deleting the Netflix app doesn't cancel your account.

faq.q: Do I get a refund if I cancel Netflix?
faq.a: Netflix's terms say no refunds or credits for part of a month. You keep watching until the period ends instead.
faq.quote: Payments are nonrefundable and there are no refunds or credits for partially used subscription periods.

faq.q: Why was I charged after cancelling Netflix?
faq.a: Netflix says you, or someone using your account, may have restarted it by accident.
faq.quote: you or someone who was using your account may have accidentally restarted it

faq.q: I pay for Netflix through Apple. How do I cancel?
faq.a: Check Membership and Billing on your Netflix account. If there's no cancel option there, you cancel through Apple in iPhone Settings.
faq.quote: If you don't see the option to cancel on your Netflix Account, you must cancel your Netflix subscription through Apple.

faq.q: If I come back later, are my profiles still there?
faq.a: Yes, if you restart within 24 months. Netflix keeps your viewing activity, ratings and game saves for that long.
faq.quote: We keep your Viewing Activity for 24 months after your account closes
